prompts.task: Treat ./service as the project root. Create ./service/.observe and copy ./service/eval/inputs/otel-audit-genai.json to ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json. Use $splunk-dashboard to generate local dashboard Terraform, variables, example tfvars, Markdown report, and Observer preview from that selected audit. Preserve the source-backed distinction between GenAI model configuration, workflow fanout, content governance, and app-computed cost; do not treat a generic cost-named metric as GenAI. Do not invent missing telemetry, expose raw content, call any network, or run Terraform.

judge_inputs: Inspect the selected audit at ./service/eval/inputs/otel-audit-genai.json and every generated file under ./service/.observe, especially terraform/dashboards.tf, dashboards.md, and dashboards.preview.json.
Inspect ./trace.jsonl to verify audit-gate ordering, the three routed local dashboard references, and the absence of network calls or Terraform execution.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response and ./grade.json for run guard checks.
rubric: Binds the selected canonical GenAI audit and creates a separate GenAI dashboard group and dashboard containing panels for each of the five source-backed gen_ai metrics; it neither silently drops those metrics nor invents unavailable telemetry.

Classifies gen_ai.request.model.config.mismatch.count and gen_ai.model.deployment.readiness as genai-model-config, gen_ai.workflow.fanout.count as genai-workflow-fanout, gen_ai.content.redaction.failures.count as genai-content-governance, and gen_ai.request.cost as genai-cost, with the classifications visible in the report or artifact names/descriptions.

Uses a time_series sum for mismatch, fanout, governance-outcome, and app-computed cost metrics, and a single_value panel with an optional trend for deployment readiness; all SignalFlow is filtered to the audited checkout service.

Does not classify checkout.order.cost as GenAI merely because its name contains cost, and does not emit any raw prompt, completion, user, session, or tool-argument content in Terraform, preview, reports, or dimensions.

Writes valid three-level Terraform with a signalfx_dashboard_group, signalfx_dashboard, one signalfx_*_chart resource per referenced panel, bounded 12-column layout, sensitive api_token variable, and no detector-only detect()/when()/threshold() tail.

Writes schemaVersion 1 dashboards.preview.json whose groups -> dashboards -> charts tree agrees with the Terraform resources, chart types, programs, and grid positions and uses only time_series|single_value|list|heatmap|text|table.

Writes dashboards.md with source-backed category and chart rationale, explicitly records the skipped generic checkout.order.cost metric and reason, and reports missing signals only as prerequisites rather than fabricated panels.

Uses the dashboard skill's local progressive route after the audit gate, performs no network access or Terraform execution, and hands off to a later apply or $splunk-dashboard-publish step without claiming anything was deployed.
